title: The Great Train Robbery and The South Coast Raiders
subtitle: A crime novel
description: London, one year before the Great Train Robbery. Under pressure from a loan shark, Alfredo turns to crime—and finds himself drawn towards train robbers and murder. A fictional take on a notorious heist, informed by a detective’s experience.

title: An Inspector Recalls
subtitle: Memoirs of a Railway Detective
description: A candid account of a life in railway policing, from joining the force in 1968 to the gangsters, investigations and police culture of the decades that followed. Personal history meets the world behind the badge.

title: Rot at the Core
subtitle: The Serious Crimes of a Detective Sergeant
description: Graham Satchwell and Winston Trew examine the corruption of Detective Sergeant Derek Ridgewell and the wrongful convictions of the Oval Four. An account of injustice, its human consequences, and the long pursuit of the truth.

title: Great Train Robbery Confidential
subtitle: The Cop and the Robber Follow New Lines of Enquiry
description: An experienced railway detective revisits one of Britain’s most infamous crimes. A fresh investigation into the Great Train Robbery, looking beyond its familiar mythology and following new lines of enquiry.

title: A Sick Business
subtitle: Counterfeit Medicines and Organised Crime
description: An investigation into counterfeit medicines and their connections with organised crime.
